recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Draw the header band: a light-gray (#D9D9D9) rectangle spanning the full slide width from 0% to 15% of slide height.
3. Center the title in the header band in large bold sans-serif: 'Nearest Neighbors ' in dark red (#8B0000) immediately followed by '(NN) Example' in blue (#0000CC), both parts in the same font and size.
4. Place the slide-number badge at the top-right corner of the header band: a yellow circle (#FFF9A0) with a thin dark outline containing '44' in small dark (#000000) text.
5. Draw the content frame: a thin dark-red (#8B0000) rectangle border enclosing the body area below the header (approx. x 8-92% of width, y 16-96% of height).
6. Build the left scatter plot in the left panel (approx. x 10-48%, y 18-88%): L-shaped dark-red (#8B0000) axes — vertical axis pointing up, horizontal axis pointing right, arrowheads at both ends, no ticks or labels.
7. In the left plot, place three clusters of filled circles with thin dark outlines: approx. 11 green (#7CFC00) dots in the upper-left, approx. 9 cyan (#00E5E5) dots in the upper-right, approx. 6 orange/tan (#F5C98A) dots at bottom-center.
8. In the left plot, place the query marker: one larger red (#FF0000) filled dot near the center, a dark-red (#8B0000) '?' to its right, and a small gray (#808080) curved arrow/cursor just above-left of the red dot.
9. Center the left caption beneath the left panel (approx. y 88-95%): bold dark-red (#8B0000) text 'Data of Three Classes'.
10. Build the right scatter plot in the right panel (approx. x 52-90%, y 18-88%): duplicate the same dark-red L-shaped axes and the same dots as step 7, plus the red (#FF0000) query dot near the center.
11. From the red query dot, draw 26 thin light-pink (#F4C2C2) straight lines — one to each of the 26 cluster dots (11 green + 9 cyan + 6 orange) — each ending in a small red arrowhead pointing at the target dot.
12. Highlight the nearest neighbor: the closest orange dot, located just below-left of the red query dot — fill it yellow (#FFF200) and draw a dashed dark-red (#8B0000) circle around it.
13. Center the right caption beneath the right panel (approx. y 88-95%): bold dark-red (#8B0000) text 'Nearest Neighbor is the Orange class'.
